tldr: Sun through the 11th house brings focus to friends, networks, community, hopes, and collective work.
body: Sun transiting the 11th house illuminates friends, networks, community, hopes, and collective work. For about a month, attention, vitality, and conscious focus move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a visibility transit: it shows where your life force wants to be recognized, strengthened, and chosen consciously.
business: Sun supports community contribution and future goals: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Ego inflation, overexposure, or belonging without discernment.
advice: Use the spotlight in the 11th house deliberately. Work with friends, networks, community, hopes, and collective work without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from Marie Satori house-transit material.
